kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Illustrative reference Rs 533 = the DRHP's own peer-median P/E (34.57x, Praj Industries, 14-Aug-2025 prices) x FY25 EPS Rs 15.42 (p. 168). It is not a price band. The last private price was Rs 225 per share in Apr-2024 secondary transfers, Rs 75 after the 2:1 bonus (p. 173); selling shareholders' average cost is mostly Rs 36.72 (p. 45).

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow Rs 30.39 cr / -11.69 cr / 65.51 cr FY23-25 against PAT Rs 94.81 / 144.17 / 152.01 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT about 22% (owners' PAT basis). Working capital rose from 27.8% to 63.5% of revenue as receivable days went 158 -> 197 -> 262. FY25 cash flow recovered as collections improved; typical of a technology supplier paid on municipal STP project milestones, but the trend is the key thing to track.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: Contingent liabilities tiny (Rs 0.02 cr), but subsidiary SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH faces a EUR 5.60 m (Rs 56.75 cr, 8.7% of FY25 net worth) liquidated-damages suit in Portugal over a 2018 STP supply; defence filed 28-Oct-2024, pending.

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: G B C A & Associates LLP audit with no qualifications; two overseas subsidiaries (FY25 assets Rs 23.02 cr, revenue Rs 20.07 cr) are consolidated on unaudited, management-certified accounts. Small, but should be audited by the RHP.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -66.9% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: 1:5 split (05-Sep-2024) and 2:1 bonus (05-Sep-2024) are reflected: EPS 10.05 / 15.16 / 15.42 FY23-25 are on the post-bonus count of 9,34,11,270 shares.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax 26.1% of cumulative FY23-25 PBT; income tax paid Rs 135.80 cr over three years. Profit is taxed in cash.

comfort.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
comfort.detail: Related-party dealings outside the group are small (Turbomax India purchases Rs 1.58 cr FY25). Large intra-group loans to SWT subsidiaries (Vasudha, HWTPL, Pentagen) are eliminated on consolidation. Dividends Rs 31.14 cr paid in FY25.

comfort.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
comfort.detail: Goodwill Rs 2.81 cr; other intangibles Rs 7.26 cr are service-concession rights acquired with a subsidiary in Oct-2023, amortised Rs 5.57 cr a year - not capitalised development costs.

comfort.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
comfort.detail: Top customer 16.76% and top-10 61.37% of FY25 revenue (EPC contractors building municipal STPs); top-10 suppliers 47.71% of purchases. Usual for a project-linked technology supplier.

comfort.title: Monitoring agency
comfort.detail: Fresh issue Rs 150 cr: a monitoring agency is mandatory above Rs 50 cr; to be named in the RHP.

adjustments.item: Gains on sale of property, plant and equipment and investment property (in other income)
adjustments.reason: Gains on sale of PPE Rs 0.11 / 1.64 / 5.65 cr and of investment property Rs 1.99 / 1.66 / 3.96 cr FY23-25. Real cash gains, but one-off and not from operations.

adjustments.item: Share of profit of a joint venture and associate that no longer exist
adjustments.reason: The joint venture ceased on 08-Aug-2023 and the associate became a subsidiary; the share of profit (Rs 1.31 cr FY23, Rs 2.41 cr FY24) does not recur.
Insurance claim of Rs 0.52 cr in FY25 other income (WWT segment note).

adjustments.item: Interest on fixed deposits, loans and mutual-fund gains (treasury income)
adjustments.reason: Recurring while the company holds cash, but non-operating; excluding it gives the operating P/E. Shown for information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY25 PAT by -5.2%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY23-FY25 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 40.5x reported and 42.1x adjusted.
